scope: Two prior engine tests amended for the separate run blob store (#1603 review comment 1, owner decision option A). (1) test_catalog_wiring.py::test_no_setting_holds_an_aigateway_credential: the pinned set of secret-shaped Settings fields gains blob_s3_access_key and blob_s3_secret_key, with a reviewed rationale comment mirroring artifact_s3_*; the four existing entries and the assertion message are unchanged. (2) test_chart_render_garage_selector.py: test_the_app_service_does_not_select_garage_pods and test_the_garage_selector_is_the_app_identity_plus_the_garage_component pick the results Garage StatefulSet and Service by EXACT name (url4-cloud-url4-cloud-garage) instead of the first object with 'garage' in its name; the first test also asserts that no App Service selects the blob Garage's pods and that each Garage Service selects only its own Garage's pods. Every prior assertion about the results Garage is kept; test_the_app_service_selects_only_the_control_plane_pods is unchanged.
reason: Owner decision (Sergey, 2026-11-03, Q1(a) and Q2(a)): blobs get their own S3 store, so the App must hold a second, separate S3 credential (a Secret value read by named secretKeyRef; a leak grants read/write on the blob bucket only), which the credential tripwire requires to be listed with a rationale; and the chart now renders a second bundled Garage (<fullname>-garage-blobs, component garage-blobs) whose objects also contain 'garage' in their names, so the selector tests' first-match lookups would pick the blob Garage. The tests now name the store they check and cover the second one.

amendments.scope: #1603 review round 2, item 1 (unset blob store fails closed: typed 503 from the blob routes, typed BlobStoreNotConfigured from the Runner's blob_reader_from_env). (1) test_blob_routes.py and test_blob_review_hardening.py: the _app fixtures add blob_store='filesystem' and blobs_dir=<tmp>/artifacts (the same tmp directory, so test_corrupted_stored_bytes_are_500_digest_mismatch and test_the_artifact_startup_sweep_also_ages_out_blobs, whose paths already sit below blobs_dir, needed no edit); no assertion changed. (2) test_blob_wiring.py: _env adds BLOB_STORE=filesystem and BLOBS_DIR (covers test_the_filesystem_store_reads_what_the_app_wrote and test_the_reader_is_scoped_to_this_run); test_s3_selection_builds_the_s3_backend adds the BLOB_S3_* settings and asserts the separately configured blob bucket instead of the follow-the-artifact-bucket behaviour. (3) .github/scripts/verify_chart_wiring.py (not under tests/, recorded for the audit trail): the existing check 'an operator's own blob endpoint replaces the bundled blob Garage' renders with --set blobs.storage.s3.existingSecret=blob-credentials; its assertion is unchanged. Base blobs are this branch's pre-change head 8f47715c9.
amendments.reason: Owner decision (Sergey, 2026-11-04): with no independently configured blob store, blob upload and fetch are off — follow mode (the artifact directory/bucket) is removed, so tests that relied on it must configure a blob store; and an external blob endpoint without credentials now fails render (item 4), so the verifier's external-endpoint render must supply an existingSecret.
